checks.validationHelperSource:
$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
$scriptPath = '/workspace/TC/apps/desktop/windows-ui.ps1'
$parseErrors = $null; $tokens = $null
$ast = [System.Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile($scriptPath, [ref]$tokens, [ref]$parseErrors)
if ($parseErrors.Count) { $parseErrors | ForEach-Object { "$($_.Extent.StartLineNumber): $($_.Message)" }; exit 1 }
"PowerShell parser: $($tokens.Count) tokens, zero errors"
$source = [regex]::Match([IO.File]::ReadAllText($scriptPath), "-TypeDefinition @'\r?\n([\s\S]*?)\r?\n'@").Groups[1].Value
if (!$source) { throw 'C# source was not found' }
[void][Reflection.Assembly]::LoadFrom('/tmp/tc-powershell/Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.dll')
[void][Reflection.Assembly]::LoadFrom('/tmp/tc-powershell/Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.dll')
$options = [Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.CSharpParseOptions]::Default.WithLanguageVersion([Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.LanguageVersion]::CSharp5)
$tree = [Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.CSharpSyntaxTree]::ParseText($source, $options, 'TCReadOnlyWindows.cs', [Text.Encoding]::UTF8)
$referenceRoot = '/tmp/tc-powershell/net48/build/.NETFramework/v4.8'
$references = @('mscorlib.dll','System.dll','System.Core.dll','System.Drawing.dll','WindowsBase.dll','UIAutomationClient.dll','UIAutomationTypes.dll') | ForEach-Object {
  [Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.MetadataReference]::CreateFromFile((Join-Path $referenceRoot $_))
}
$compilationOptions = [Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.CSharpCompilationOptions]::new([Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.OutputKind]::DynamicallyLinkedLibrary)
$compilation = [Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.CSharp.CSharpCompilation]::Create('TCNativeValidation', [Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.SyntaxTree[]]@($tree), [Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.MetadataReference[]]$references, $compilationOptions)
$stream = [IO.MemoryStream]::new()
$result = $compilation.Emit($stream)
$result.Diagnostics | ForEach-Object { $_.ToString() }
if (!$result.Success) { exit 1 }
"C# 5 compiled against Microsoft .NET Framework 4.8 / Windows UIA reference assemblies: $($stream.Length) bytes"
$stream.Dispose()
